limitations: Test coefficients between outputs and targets are generally not very high (all less than 0.8).
Subjective evaluations are varied between individual users and cannot be completely represented by computer models.
Data from field surveys were from a wide range of situations, not specific positions, which may affect model predictions.
Only loudness and sharpness were studied as psychoacoustic parameters due to software limitations; other parameters like roughness were not included.
